title: Boss-Wipe Count Before Clear
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=raid:attempt
| stats sum(eval(if(result="wipe",1,0))) as wipes sum(eval(if(result="clear",1,0))) as clears by boss
| sort - wipes
description: Counts wipe attempts and successful clears by boss encounter.
value: This is a practical difficulty and progression signal for co-op PvE play because it shows where practice is still expensive.
implementation: Capture raid outcomes by boss from your guild log, Discord bot, or exported encounter history.
visualization: Bar chart of wipes and clears by boss encounter.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which bosses take the most failed attempts before your group finally clears them.
